(2) --out golden/jhora-bodies --ini BodyTypeOuterPlanet=1 --ini BodyTypeUpagraha=0 --ini BodyTypeVarnadas=0 --ini BodyTypeGrahaArudha=0 (the [BodiesToShow] flags edited by 32821 / 32930, dialog 130).
